releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.29

- Updates no longer leave the downloaded installer behind. Each update used to
  keep its full 65 MB file in the app's storage, invisibly, forever; several
  updates in that added up to hundreds of megabytes. The app now clears the old
  one before downloading the next, so it never holds more than a single copy.
- Tapping Update twice in quick succession no longer starts two downloads.
